title: Your Call Is Important To Us
preview: Prior auth, patient portals, and a very patient patient.

jokes.setup: My insurer told me prior authorization usually takes just five to seven business days.
jokes.punchline: Fortunately, my appendix has a very flexible schedule and a strong sense of customer loyalty.

jokes.setup: The new patient portal lets you view your test results the instant they're ready.
jokes.punchline: You'll be thrilled to see them before your doctor does, and to learn that "abnormal" is a lowercase word with a very uppercase font.

cartoon.caption: “Thank you for your patience, Mr. Hale. Your estimated wait is still ‘about fifteen minutes.’”
cartoon.alt: A bearded patient with a beard reaching the floor and tangled in cobwebs sits calmly in a waiting room while a receptionist holds up a clipboard.
